pred.description: 'duty' count differs; 'no' count differs
pred.old: We will pay damages for bodily injury or property damage for which an insured is legally responsible because of an auto accident. We will settle or defend, as we consider appropriate, any claim or suit asking for these damages. Our duty to settle or defend ends when our limit of liability has been paid.
pred.new: We will pay damages for bodily injury or property damage for which an insured is legally responsible because of an auto accident. We will settle, but have no duty to defend, any claim or suit asking for these damages. Our duty to settle or defend ends when our limit of liability has been paid.

pred.description: 'lesser' count differs; 'greater' count differs
pred.old: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision, less the applicable deductible shown in the Declarations. Payment will not exceed the lesser of the actual cash value of the damaged property or the amount necessary to repair or replace it.
pred.new: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision, less the applicable deductible shown in the Declarations. Payment will not exceed the greater of the actual cash value of the damaged property or the amount necessary to repair or replace it.

calls.text:
All seven proposed items are correct and material, and no material changes were missed.

- **Not material (left out):** Section 2.3 changes "legally entitled" to "entitled by law", and Section 4.1 changes "occurring" to "take place". Both are rewording with the same meaning. The new date format for Policy Period Start and Continuous Coverage Since is formatting only.
- **Section 4.2:** The excess-insurance rule now covers only vehicles you neither own nor regularly use. That narrows when the policy acts as excess, so it is material.

pred.new: $25,000 each accident

pred.description: Uninsured/underinsured motorist limits cut from $100,000/$300,000 to $25,000/$50,000.
pred.old: $100,000 each person / $300,000 each accident
pred.new: $25,000 each person / $50,000 each accident

pred.description: Medical payments limit cut from $5,000 to $1,000 per person.
pred.old: $5,000 each person
pred.new: $1,000 each person

pred.description: The fraud exclusion now requires intentional misrepresentation. Knowing concealment is no longer listed as grounds for denying coverage, which narrows the exclusion.
pred.old: We do not provide coverage for any insured who has knowingly concealed or misrepresented any material fact or circumstance in connection with this policy or a claim.
pred.new: We do not provide coverage for any insured who has intentionally misrepresented any material fact or circumstance in connection with this policy or a claim.

pred.description: Comprehensive theft coverage is limited to theft of the entire vehicle, so partial theft (e.g., stolen parts) is no longer listed. This narrows coverage.
pred.old: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, including fire, theft, vandalism, flood, and contact with animals, less the applicable deductible shown in the Declarations.
pred.new: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, including fire, theft of the entire vehicle, vandalism, flood, and contact with animals, less the applicable deductible shown in the Declarations.

pred.description: The excess-only rule now covers only vehicles the insured neither owns nor regularly uses. Non-owned vehicles that the insured regularly uses are no longer within the excess provision, which changes how other-insurance priority is applied to them.
pred.old: Any insurance we provide for a vehicle you do not own is excess over any other collectible insurance.
pred.new: Any insurance we provide for a vehicle you do not own or regularly use is excess over any other collectible insurance.

pred.old: (section not present)

calls.text:
All seven proposed changes are correct, and none were missed.

- **Removed:** none.
- **Not material:**
  - 2.3: "legally entitled to recover" became "entitled by law to recover", which means the same thing.
  - 4.1: "occurring within" became "that take place within", which also means the same thing.
  - Policy Period Start and Continuous Coverage Since: only the date format changed.
- **Unchanged:** Total Policy Premium, the deductibles, Rental Reimbursement, Bodily Injury limits and sections 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.2, 3.4, 5.1 and 5.3.

pred.description: rewording only
pred.old: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, including fire, theft, vandalism, flood, and contact with animals, less the applicable deductible shown in the Declarations.
pred.new: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, including fire, theft of the entire vehicle, vandalism, flood, and contact with animals, less the applicable deductible shown in the Declarations.

pred.description: Policy period end date changed, extending the term.
Continuous coverage start date moved two years earlier.
Medical payments limit increased.
pred.old: $1,000 each person
pred.new: $2,500.00 each person

pred.description: Premium decreased.
Liability exclusion broadened to cover maintenance, as well as ownership and use, of a vehicle used to carry persons or property for a fee.
pred.old: arising from the ownership or use of a vehicle
pred.new: arising from the ownership, maintenance or use of a vehicle

pred.description: Uninsured motorist coverage now excludes hit-and-run vehicles.
pred.old: uninsured motor vehicle because of bodily injury
pred.new: uninsured motor vehicle, other than a hit-and-run vehicle, because of bodily injury

pred.description: Excess-insurance provision narrowed. It now applies only to vehicles you neither own nor regularly use.
pred.old: a vehicle you do not own is excess
pred.new: a vehicle you do not own or regularly use is excess

pred.description: Fraud and Misrepresentation section removed.
pred.old: We do not provide coverage for any insured who has knowingly concealed or misrepresented any material fact or circumstance in connection with this policy or a claim.
pred.new: (section deleted)
